title: APEXFIN pipeline manifest
description: Governance contract for the daily pipeline. Every step must justify why it runs.

name.description: Must match a step registered via @step in code. Bidirectional consistency is enforced by `apexfin manifest validate`.

tier.description: risk_essential: staleness blocks the run. support/display_only: degrade only. research: excluded from the daily chain.

keep_daily.description: Whether this step belongs to the daily chain. A keep_daily=true step must not depend on a keep_daily=false step.

why.description: One sentence stating why this step is worth running. Empty or placeholder text fails validation. This field is the pipeline-slimming evidence.

depends_on.description: Declarative dependencies. Execution order is derived by topological sort; manual ordering is not supported by design.

critical.description: If true, failure of this step aborts the whole run.

steps.name: collect
steps.why: Without fresh raw records every downstream conclusion is stale by construction.

steps.name: process_silver
steps.why: Normalizes payloads into comparable numeric points that checks and strategies read.

steps.name: quality_gate
steps.why: Blocks the run when risk-essential series are stale, which is the core promise of this project.

steps.name: decide
steps.why: Produces the daily stance; skipped automatically when the gate is BLOCKED.

steps.name: render
steps.why: Renders the dashboard including the degraded state, which is how failures become visible.
